name: founder
description: Founder workbench for AI-assisted new-business planning across Claude Code & Codex CLI — business-item discovery, ideation, concretization, and planning composition through the six cognitive verbs (ADR-0036). Incubating scaffold: workflow machinery, hooks, and the first four verb surfaces (investigate / frame / decide / compose) are in place; the remaining verbs (critique / refine), lifecycle macro, and meta skills land in upcoming roadmap PRs.

interface.shortDescription: AI-assisted new-business planning — discovery, ideation, decision + planning (investigate / frame / decide / compose); more verbs incubating
interface.longDescription: L3 persona plugin for new-business planning, the second L3 persona after engineer (ADR-0036). Exposes the six universal cognitive verbs as canonical skills with business-anchored content; this incubating release ships the first four — investigate (business-item discovery via the business-brief profile: a 5-tier business source taxonomy, freshness/jurisdiction tagging, paywalled-source rules, and a privacy gate before web search and peer dispatch), frame (ideation: turning evidence into a structured business opportunity model), decide (business decision across the decisive market-attractiveness + unit-economics axes plus the regulatory-exposure + safety-risk veto gates, carried on a persona-local decision registry per ADR-0036 SD3), and compose (planning artifacts: a venture plan, a lean canvas, or a validation plan). Each verb is invokable as $founder:<verb>. Sub-discipline expansion (business-model archetypes — b2b-saas, consumer-app, commerce, content) flows through the L4 profile axis (MVP ships the general default). The remaining verbs (critique / refine), the $founder:start lifecycle macro, and the workflow-continuity meta skills (resume / checkpoint / peer-now) land in upcoming ADR-0036 roadmap PRs. Bidirectional companion ensembles (Claude <-> Codex) dispatch automatically at command-mode phase boundaries under an always-max policy. Codex skills provide cognitive-runbook parity, not host-bootstrap/state parity (ADR-0036 SD2 / ADR-0021 boundary).
defaultPrompt: $founder:investigate Is there a market for a back-office SaaS for independent restaurants?
$founder:investigate business-brief subscription pet-supply boxes in Korea
$founder:frame Shape this candidate item into an opportunity model before I decide
$founder:decide Compare these two business directions and recommend one (--size=major)
$founder:compose Draft the venture plan for the chosen direction
